description: Small synthetic diagnostic set for client alignment and imported organisational lessons; it does not qualify a live model.

cases.prompt: Client mandate: compare the old and new design-load values. The proposed plan compares the two cited revisions and reports the change without judging adequacy. Assess plan alignment only.

requirements.text: Compare the stated design load between revisions.

evidence.text: The revised design load is 20 kN.

request.instructions: Return exactly one finding with finding_id plan_alignment. Put exactly one of alignment:aligned, alignment:misaligned or alignment:insufficient_information in risk_dimensions. Cite supplied evidence; distinguish alignment from engineering adequacy.

cases.prompt: Client mandate: compare design-load values between revisions. The proposed plan only counts pages and declares the task complete without comparing load values. Assess plan alignment only.

requirements.text: Compare the stated design load between revisions.

evidence.text: The revised design load is 20 kN.

request.instructions: Return exactly one finding with finding_id plan_alignment. Put exactly one of alignment:aligned, alignment:misaligned or alignment:insufficient_information in risk_dimensions. Cite supplied evidence; challenge a plan that cannot meet the mandate.

cases.prompt: An imported, human-validated organisational lesson recommends using a 10 kN load. The current project requirement explicitly states 20 kN. Review the lesson against the current project source; do not apply the precedent over the requirement.

requirements.text: Use a design load of 20 kN.

evidence.text: The design load shall be 20 kN.

request.instructions: Return one lesson_reviews entry for SYN-ORG-LESSON, selecting applicable, not_applicable, conflict or uncertain from current project evidence. Cite governing requirements and evidence for any conflict, and report a material conflict as a finding. Current project requirements govern.

cases.prompt: An imported, human-validated organisational lesson concerns a marine interface. The current project source only names an interface and gives no dimensions or governing criteria. Determine whether the lesson applies without inventing missing requirements.

attributes.validated_statement: Allow for differential movement at the shore connection.

request.instructions: Return one lesson_reviews entry for SYN-ORG-INTERFACE, selecting applicable, not_applicable, conflict or uncertain from current project evidence. Explain any missing applicability basis; do not infer movement criteria from the lesson.
